svg.title: The Hessian types drawn as surfaces
svg.desc: Left: a bowl, curving up in every direction. Middle: a saddle, curving up along one axis and down along the other. Right: a trough, curving up along one axis and flat along the other. Black curves are the slices along the two axes through the origin.
svg.text: Up one way, down the other
a saddle: Hessian has both signs
Up one way, flat the other
height above the grey floor is f; the black curves are slices along the two axes through the origin
each slice bends as much as the Hessian says it does in that direction
